<slate title="Limits">
  <column id="root">
    <text id="who" muted small when={exists(usage.account.plan)}>{usage.account.label} on {usage.account.plan}</text>
    <section id="context" title="Context">

          tone={thread.context.percent > 80 ? 'warning' : 'default'}
          placeholder="No turn has reported context yet."
        >{pct(thread.context.percent)} used</text>

        tokens

        when={exists(thread.context.window)}
      />

          percent
          label="5 hour"

          tone={usage.session.percent > 80 ? 'warning' : 'default'}
          when={exists(usage.session)}
        />
        <meter
          id="week"
          percent

        />

</slate>
